complexity_O.stage0_feature_selection: O(n k d) kNN graph + O(n d) scoring (subsampled n)
complexity_O.stage2_bootstrap: O(n K d I) k-means + O(n K d) orientation/confidence
complexity_O.stage4_refinement_per_iter: O(E n_seed d_mlp) train + O(T n_held d_mlp) MC-dropout
complexity_O.federated_per_round: O(E n_k d_mlp) per client + O(P) aggregation/EMA
